# unexpand

Replace spaces with tabs through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/unexpand input.txt

moonx cli/unexpand -a -t 4 input.txt
```

Convert leading blanks by default; -a also converts later blanks. The default tab interval is eight columns.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-a`, `--all` | Convert blanks throughout each record. |
| `--first-only` | Convert leading blanks only, overriding -a and -t. |
| `-t VALUE`, `--tabs VALUE` | Select ascending stops; implies --all. Final /N or +N extends stops. Default: `8`. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

- Column tracking uses C-locale byte/control-character rules, not Unicode display width.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
